name: comp-137
blurb: Checkbox with animated strikethrough on the label using CSS transforms.
description: Pre-checked todo checkbox with circular styling and animated line-through effect. The strikethrough line scales in using CSS transforms when checked.
use_when: Building polished todo lists with smooth animations.
avoid_when: Simple task lists—the animation adds complexity without functional benefit.
a11y: Checkbox and label properly associated. Animation doesn't interfere with keyboard navigation. Semantic state via checkbox.
